blocks.text: ATLANTA — After Trae Young was introduced last for the Washington Wizards on Friday night, he took the court before tipoff, went to the corner of the floor and settled himself. Then, he jogged over to Hawks coach Quin Snyder for a pregame embrace before taking on his former team. “I don’t even know how to describe the feeling,” Young said after the Hawks topped the Wizards 139-132. “I mean, it was different. It was cool for me.” Young had 23 points, 10 assists, but also a season-high eight turnovers against the Hawks, who beat the Wizards in both games of […]...
